title: Perimeter & Area
description: Class 4 IMO — Perimeter and area: perimeter of squares and rectangles, area by counting squares, area formulas (l × b and side × side), and real-life word problems.

topics.title: Perimeter of Square & Rectangle
topics.concept:
The perimeter is the total distance around a shape — the sum of all its sides. For a square, perimeter = 4 × side. For a rectangle, perimeter = 2 × (length + breadth).

So a square of side 5 cm has perimeter 4 × 5 = 20 cm, and a rectangle 6 cm × 4 cm has perimeter 2 × (6 + 4) = 20 cm.

examples.problem: Find the perimeter of a square of side 5 cm.
Find the perimeter of a rectangle 6 cm by 4 cm.

recap: Perimeter = distance all the way around.

quiz.q: What is the perimeter of a square of side 7 cm?
What is the perimeter of a rectangle 8 cm by 3 cm?

topics.title: Area by Counting & Formulas
topics.concept:
The area is the space inside a shape, measured in square units (sq cm). One way is to count the unit squares that fit inside.

Faster, we use formulas: area of a rectangle = length × breadth, and area of a square = side × side. So a 5 cm × 3 cm rectangle has area 15 sq cm.

examples.problem: Find the area of a square of side 4 cm.
Find the area of a rectangle 5 cm by 3 cm.

recap: Area = space inside, in square units.
Rectangle: length × breadth. Square: side × side.

quiz.q: What is the area of a square of side 6 cm?
What is the area of a rectangle 7 cm by 2 cm?

topics.title: Word Problems (Fencing, Carpet)
topics.concept: Real problems tell us whether to use perimeter or area. Fencing a garden uses the perimeter (the distance around). Carpeting or tiling a floor uses the area (the space inside).

examples.problem: A garden is 10 m by 5 m. How much fencing is needed?
A room floor is 4 m by 3 m. How much carpet is needed?

quiz.q: A square field has side 20 m. How much fencing is needed to go around it?
A floor is 6 m by 5 m. How much carpet (area) is needed?

questions.q: Perimeter is to the distance around as area is to ___ ?
questions.explanation: Area is the space inside a shape.

questions.q: What is the perimeter of a square of side 10 cm?
Which job needs the perimeter, not the area?
questions.explanation: Fencing goes around the edge, which is the perimeter.

questions.q: Continue the pattern of perimeters:  side 1 → 4, side 2 → 8, side 3 → 12, side 4 → ___ ?
questions.explanation: Perimeter of a square = 4 × side, so side 4 → 16.
